selection_process: Under the "Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (Direct Recruitment through Screening Examination) Regulations

" the Commission may hold a Screening Examination for selection of candidates for interview. Only candidates who qualify in the Screening Examination will be entitled to an Interview. The final merit order is determined by adding 75% marks in the screening test and 25% marks in the interview. The Screening Examination is Objective Type (OMR-based)

with 4 alternatives per question. Negative marking: one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for a wrong answer; a blank question carries no penalty; multiple answers to one question are treated as wrong. Minimum efficiency standard: SC/ST candidates must secure at least 35% marks in the Screening Examination; candidates of other categories must secure at least 40% marks
to be placed in the merit/select list. Research Scholars of the Chief Minister Fellowship Programme who have completed their tenure are given additional weightage in the screening examination
graded by the maximum marks of the exam and the duration of the fellowship completed. Original certificates are required for verification at the time of interview
along with a passport-size photograph attested by the head of the department/institution or a Gazetted Officer.
how_to_apply: Obtain a One Time Registration (O.T.R.) Number from the Commission's O.T.R. portal, https://otr.pariksha.nic.in, at least 72 hours before submitting the online application (if not already registered).
Visit the Commission's official website, https://uppsc.up.nic.in, and click "ALL NOTIFICATIONS/ADVERTISEMENTS."
Click "Apply" against the relevant post, then "Authenticate with O.T.R." and enter your O.T.R. Number; authenticate via O.T.P. or O.T.R. password.

Second Stage: On the Applicant Dashboard, click "Submit Details" under "Application Part-2"; your address and personal details will auto-populate from O.T.R., along with preferential qualifications for the post - select Yes/No for each.
Third Stage: Proceed to fee payment via SBI MOPS (Net Banking/Card Payments/Other Payment Modes); take a printout of the Payment Transaction Slip.
Fourth Stage: Your completed application form will be displayed; take a printout and keep it safe.

After submitting online, send self-attested photocopies of all academic/required documents along with the printout of the online form via registered/speed post or by hand, to reach the Commission's office by the hard-copy submission deadline.
Use a separate A-4 size envelope for each post applied for, with the auto-filled address-slip (downloaded from the Candidate Dashboard) pasted on it.

content_sections.text: A total of 1156 vacancies have been notified - 44 for Professor and 1112 for Assistant Professor - across General Recruitment and Special Recruitment categories in various medical specialties. The number of vacancies of all mentioned posts may increase/decrease depending on circumstances/requirements. Note: The Professor "Special Recruitment" total above (9) reflects the vacancy figures listed against each speciality in the source; a separate cross-tabulated grand total was not stated in the notification for this section. content_sections.heading: UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only those candidates who possess the requisite qualification acquired from a recognized university/institution at the time of applying, and who hold the essential qualification till the last date of receipt of the online application, are eligible. Minimum educational qualification alone is not sufficient for being called for interview - mere eligibility does not entitle a candidate to selection. Relevant Service Rules: The Uttar Pradesh State Medical College Teacher's Service Rules, 1990 (as amended).

rows.general_qualification_pattern: Relevant postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch. as applicable to the specialty), plus 3 years' experience as Associate Professor in the subject in a recognised medical institution (or equivalent alternative routes specified per specialty, e.g. Specialist Medical Officer of Armed Forces, Senior Consultant with NBE-recognised teaching experience), plus at least 2 research publications after becoming Associate Professor (as first three authors) and completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research

Relevant postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch. as applicable to the specialty), plus 1 year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject after obtaining the degree (or equivalent alternative routes specified per specialty, e.g. Tutor/Demonstrator experience, Specialist Medical Officer of Armed Forces, non-teaching Consultant with 2 years' experience in a 220+ bed Government hospital, or diploma holders with specified years of Senior Resident/Specialist experience)

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Under the "Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (Direct Recruitment through Screening Examination) Regulations, 2025," the Commission may hold a Screening Examination for selection of candidates for interview. Only candidates who qualify in the Screening Examination will be entitled to an Interview. The final merit order is determined by adding 75% marks in the screening test and 25% marks in the interview . The Screening Examination is Objective Type (OMR-based), with 4 alternatives per question. Negative marking: one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for a wrong answer; a blank question carries no penalty; multiple answers to one question are treated as wrong. Minimum efficiency standard: SC/ST candidates must secure at least 35% marks in the Screening Examination; candidates of other categories must secure at least 40% marks, to be placed in the merit/select list. Research Scholars of the Chief Minister Fellowship Programme who have completed their tenure are given additional weightage in the screening examination, graded by the maximum marks of the exam and the duration of the fellowship completed. Original certificates are required for verification at the time of interview, along with a passport-size photograph attested by the head of the department/institution or a Gazetted Officer.

faq.question: Q1. What is UPPSC Medical Professor & Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is UPPSC's recruitment drive under Advertisement No. D-1/E-1/2026 for 1156 posts (44 Professor and 1112 Assistant Professor) in the Medical Education Department, U.P. (Allopathy), across various medical specialties.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 1156 vacancies are available - 44 for Professor and 1112 for Assistant Professor, spread across General and Special Recruitment categories in numerous specialties.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for payment of the online application fee and submission of the online application is 01.09.2026. Correction/modification is allowed till 08.09.2026, and hard copies must reach the Commission by 15.09.2026 (till 05:00 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for Professor is 35 to 55 years, and for Assistant Professor is 26 to 40 years, calculated as on 1 July 2026, with relaxation available for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 105/- for UR/EWS/OBC, Rs. 65/- for SC/ST, Rs. 25/- for Disabled category, and Rs. 65/- for Ex-Servicemen, inclusive of the online process fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a relevant postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch. depending on the specialty) along with specified teaching experience - 3 years as Associate Professor for Professor posts, and 1 year as Senior Resident for Assistant Professor posts (with alternative eligibility routes specified for certain specialties).

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first obtain an O.T.R. Number from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in, then apply through the four-stage online process on https://uppsc.up.nic.in, including fee payment and final form submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UPPSC Professor & Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection may involve a Screening Examination (Objective Type, with negative marking) followed by an Interview, with the final merit determined by 75% screening test marks and 25% interview marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UPPSC Professor and Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Professor posts carry Pay Level-14, and Assistant Professor posts carry Pay Level-11, as per the applicable pay matrix.

faq.question: Q10. Is there reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. As per the notification, reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities has not been identified for Government Medical Colleges under the Medical Education Department for these posts.
